name: Ferienwohnung Streif
beschreibung: The Streif holiday apartment is located in the municipality of Ebbs, in the Tiroler Unterinntal near the border with Deutschland. The surroundings are characterized by the Kaisergebirge and offer a quiet, rural stay. The apartment is modernly furnished and accommodates up to four people. Guests can expect a well-equipped kitchen and a cozy living room. The surrounding area offers activities such as hiking, cycling, and in winter skiing in the nearby Zahmer Kaiser ski area. The town of Kufstein is only a few kilometers away and invites you to cultural excursions. The atmosphere is characterized by the tranquility of the Tiroler Voralpenlandschaft.
